card.title: The Greatest Hero: The Book of Romans

metadata.author: Kaleidoscope Kids Bibles, author is Joanna Kimbrel
metadata.description: Kaleidoscope is reimagining biblical resources for children of all ages. In beautifully retold single-volumes, we make the whole of the Bible come alive using language kids can easily understand. From Genesis to Revelation, get ready to experience the Bible in a whole new way!
